messages:
Nadia: Quick heads-up 10:00 PDT run: private-deploy isolation test. Focus: RBAC tighten, KMS failover, netpol enforcement + audit delivery. Need 1 infra, 1 sec observer.
Ethan: I can be infra. Which cluster? canary-onprem-ams.
Priyanka: We'll validate two things specifically: 1) emergency SA elevation gets logged with orig-principal; 2) KMS rotate doesn't break model-serving decryption.
Oscar: For KMS, use Vault transit HSM path. Standard sequence: `vault write transit/keys/ri-main rotate` -> `vault write transit/keys/ri-main disabled=true` -> `vault write transit/keys/ri-main-promote promote=true`. Ops confirmed standby key is in sync.
Marta: Pentest flagged `vault-proxy` forwarding node metadata in 2.0.x. Canary is 2.1.0. Staging still 1.9.8. Patch staging before any rotate there.
Nadia: Good catch. Patch plan: Marta will roll proxy to 2.1.1 on staging two hours before the drill.
Ethan: Netpol: apply egress deny-by-default then explicit allow to `outbound-proxy` namespace. Sample: ```apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-default
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes:
  - Egress
  egress: []
```
Priyanka: Then apply a narrow allow for proxy traffic:```apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: allow-proxy-egress
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          role: outbound-proxy
    ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 3128
```
Oscar: Audit: ensure kube-apiserver policy captures `system:serviceaccount:infra:emergency` with level RequestResponse for secrets and rolebindings. Filebeat must tag events: `env=canary-onprem-ams,test=isolation-2026-04`. SIEM query to validate: `GET /_search?q=test:isolation-2026-04&size=10`.
Marta: I'll watch vault-proxy logs for any `token-forward` or `metadata` entries. If found, stop the drill.
Ethan: Rollback steps: re-enable old key (`vault write transit/keys/ri-main disabled=false`), restart runtime pods, remove the netpols. Keep runbook snippet in /ops/runbooks/priv-isolation-runbook.md.
Priyanka: Detection rule: `MissingAuditRBAC` fires if no `rbac:grant` event within 90s of the simulated elevation. PagerDuty routing set to sec-oncall then infra-oncall.
Nadia: Also ensure node-level block to metadata endpoint on canary: apply daemonset with `iptables -I OUTPUT -d 169.254.169.254 -j DROP`.
Oscar: Note: client key cache TTL must be <= 3m. I'll bump configmap `runtime.key_cache_ttl=120` for the window and restart pods.
Marta: Confirmed staging patched plan. I'll post a short post-check log snippet after staging run.
sec-bot: Incident CREATED ISC-2026-04-15 (mode: drill) 10:00 PDT. Runbook: /ops/runbooks/priv-isolation-runbook.md
Nadia: Action items: Marta patch staging; Oscar TTL override + restart; Ethan apply netpols + node block; Priyanka configure filebeat tags + SIEM saved search; I'll run the drill and call go/no-go at T-15.
Ethan: :thumbsup:
Priyanka: Will add the SIEM saved search and share link in thread.
Nadia: If any unexpected telemetry appears (token-forwarding or missing audit events) abort and escalate. Thanks all.
